description: Use this when the task requires finding a mug or similar small kitchen item.
content: Mugs are often found on countertops rather than inside cabinets. When searching for a mug, check countertop surfaces first before opening multiple cabinets, as this saves time and avoids unnecessary exploration.

description: Use when the target objects are not visible in the initial location.

description: Use when a take action fails or returns "Nothing happens."
content: If attempting to take an object fails, the object may not be reachable or may have already been moved. Re-examine the surface or check inventory to confirm what is actually available before retrying.

title: Open containers before placing items inside
description: Use when the target container is closed or its contents are unknown.
